items.q: Is Grantham saying AI itself is fake?
items.a: No — **bubble ≠ scam**. "The great bubbles always occur around the **very most important ideas**" (railroads, internet, AI). Capital still **over-invests**; Amazon fell **92%** in 2000 before inheriting retail. Peak/burst window is **days to years**, not decades.

items.q: How bad could a drawdown get for AI mega-caps?
items.a: High-flyers could fall **70%+** from unprecedented levels; Nasdaq fell **82%** in 2000. SpaceX framing a quarter of global GDP as addressable market is his **euphoria signal** — "like they tell stories about the **South Sea bubble**."

items.q: What simple allocation does he recommend right now?
items.a: "**Don't own US stocks.**" Portfolio sketch: ~**60% non-US / EM equity**, **5–10% precious metals**, some sensible real estate, rest in **bonds/cash**. No crypto — he expects it to go to **zero**.

items.q: Why won't your advisor tell you to get out?
items.a: **Career-risk mismatch**: Wall Street never says "get out" in bull markets. In 1999, **99%** of the analyst engine room agreed a bear market was coming yet marketing stayed bullish. GMO lost **half its book** being 2¼ years early in 1998–99. "**No help is coming**."

items.q: Why is he cautious on property even after a crash?
items.a: UK housing went from **3.4× income (1994)** to **10×+** today — even a **30% drop** stays expensive. Population decline + baby bust means **fewer bidders**, not automatic appreciation.

items.q: What practical advice does he give for harder times?
items.a: Keep a **cash reserve**, hold a **useful job**, upskill, make friends, build tight community. Founders should **lock up capital now** and brace for a post-burst funding drought. Plan as if times won't be easy.

items.q: What fertility trend does Grantham call unsustainable?
items.a: Sperm counts fell from ~**100M/mL in 1970** to ~**35** today (~**2.5%/yr**) — on pace toward median zero by ~**2045**. Drivers include **phthalates, BPA, PFAS, microplastics**, and pesticides.

items.q: Where is the highest-leverage personal action?
items.a: For pregnancy: **no cosmetics** + **organic dirty dozen** for ~9 months could eliminate ~**half** of fertility damage. EU banned ~**1,500** cosmetic chemicals vs US ~**12**; use scan apps (Yuka, EWG).

items.q: How does he frame benevolent AI?
items.a: "When was there ever a case where a **higher intelligence** was benevolent in a sustainable way to a lower intelligence? The one example is **mothers to babies**." Jobs face disruption from robotics + AI; practical skills matter if complexity unravels.

**Maternal mortality**: Norway ~**0** vs US ~**21/100K**. He recommends Denmark, Japan, France, Germany over the US for safety nets and life expectancy — US expectancy flat ~**15 years** while the Sweden gap widens.
